Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the intro last week. We'd like to schedule a 45-minute product demo for the procurement and logistics teams. Does Mar 3 at 11:00 AM PT work on your side?

I've attached a draft mutual action plan and our budget timing note for context (mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx, BluePike_budget_timing.pdf).

Hi Kayla —

Thanks for the calendar invite and the MAP. Quick heads-up: my manager (Laura) just flagged that several of your stakeholders are in the middle of an FY planning window that finishes the week of Mar 1. Procurement is likely to defer any new spend commitments until the FY reset is complete.

Given that, we have two practical options so we don't lose momentum:
- Keep the Mar 3 slot as a focused technical walk-through (SME-to-SME, no execs) so your team can validate fit, then schedule an executive/finance-facing demo the week of Mar 15; or
- Move the full demo to the week of Mar 15 so procurement can join and we can discuss commercial terms.

Laura and Jasmine are cc'd — Jasmine can lead the technical run-through if you want to keep the earlier slot. If you prefer a later date, we can propose three windows next week (Mar 15–19) and lock one.

Let me know which path you prefer and I’ll update the MAP and send new invites.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0142
